record.learning: Compose defunctionalized systems at the ordinary source-Program boundary: merge components into one typed Control IR Body, then reuse the substrate compiler's canonical handler and morphism lowering. The linker owns ID remapping, schema interning, Failure-map lowering, and residual calculation; execution must see only the resulting BPI1. Runtime callbacks, a World image, or a second interpreter are evidence that composition happened at the wrong boundary.
evidence: Boundary Program.component() exposes the exact generic compiler input without a second semantic owner.
World System Linker v1 merges root and provider Programs, emits Boundary effect_handlers/effect_morphisms, and System.Program.image() produces ordinary BPI1.
Dynamic non-identity Failure morphisms lower into ordinary enum-tag Control IR branches; void provider results lower into explicit portable unit values, with no runtime World callback.
The linked BPI1 advances through Boundary Process semantics and returns the provider-owned residual request after the internal handler reduction.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 12/12 steps and 7/7 tests; zig build check passed 107/107 steps and 48/48 tests.
record.application: For future multi-program algebraic-effect composition, keep the build-time linker above the substrate's validated compiler input and below frontends. Prove every component-local identity transformation, total Failure mapping, internal-effect elimination, and residual effect through the same final image and runtime kernel.
record.source: World System Linker v1 implementation and exact-head proof

record.learning: A compile-time graph linker must keep four identities distinct: declaration inventory, rooted reachability, keyed topology, and source-site occurrence. Tuple order is not graph identity, declaration presence is not reachability, and type equality is not occurrence equality. Assign dense component IDs by rooted semantic traversal and derive residual metadata from each reachable source occurrence; otherwise equivalent graphs drift while different residual sites collapse.
evidence: Serial standard, footgun, invariant, complexity, and fresh-eyes reviews on World head ab79f6d independently exposed declaration-only reachability, type-set residual deduplication, and handler-order BPI1 drift.
Review Fold admitted CEX-fed3a3f571ab676b31f711d1, CEX-c4d58712f4d9b8a2554145bd, and CEX-6fd3715424509fd06b82e520.
The successor discovers providers by root component effect-site order, rejects component sites absent from Control IR reachability, and retains one residual catalog entry per reachable source site.
Omission witnesses compare BPI1 bytes under swapped handler declarations, retain two equal morphism targets as two residual occurrences, and reject a declared but unreachable effect site.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 14/14 steps and 10/10 tests; zig build check passed 109/109 steps and 51/51 tests.
record.application: For graph compilers and linkers, choose one rooted traversal for canonical IDs, use the source IR's reachability relation for admission, and preserve occurrences until the owning compiler performs any lawful quotient. Never use caller collection order or set-like type deduplication as a semantic identity shortcut.
record.source: Actuating serial review successor for World System Linker v1

record.learning: In a compile-time program linker, admit each source Program once at the graph-validation boundary, then operate on the admitted component projection. Do not invoke the substrate compiler from a frequently called body accessor. Keep linker-generated Failure and unit adapters in distinct synthetic reductions so authored source instructions and block costs remain exact.
evidence: Placing boundary.program admission inside body(Program) left zig build check-world-system-link-v1 compiling at full CPU for more than six minutes; moving admission to one validateSystem pass restored a 23-31 second uncached focused compile.

zig build check-world-system-link-v1 --summary all completed 16/16 steps with 15/15 tests, including forged-component admission, adapter-cost, void-backedge, occurrence, and shared-provider DAG witnesses.
zig build check --summary all completed 111/111 steps with 56/56 tests after separating adapters from authored reductions.
record.application: For future comptime graph compilers, separate one-time owner admission from repeated structural lookup, and model lowering adapters as explicit nodes or reductions whenever inserting operations would alter authored costs or semantic step boundaries.
record.source: Portable Defunctionalized Systems v1 World linker third construction

record.learning: For an open compile-time linker, derive the predecessor topology directly from the input spec and admitted IR, then make one plan the sole lowering carrier and independently re-derive successor topology from the emitted program. Adapt call conventions with wrapper functions instead of mutating source entries, and privatize unreachable syntax structurally so dead edges and impossible Failure domains cannot acquire linked obligations.
evidence: Serial standard, invariant, complexity, and fresh-eyes reviews on World ba751ea exposed an unreachable void-entry predecessor, conflated external roles, zero-cardinality Failure layout drift, and repeated manual topology owners.

The successor PlanFor derives Boundary reachability once, role-separates bare external authority, routes void handlers through wrappers, and uses one FailureAdapterLayout for allocation plus emission.

test/system_link_topology_v1.zig independently derives source facts from each spec and component IR, proves linked count transformations and exact dispositions, and verifies unreachable blocks become private self-loops.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 completed 18/18 steps with 21/21 tests; zig build check completed 113/113 steps with 62/62 tests.
record.application: When a linker or compiler repeatedly misses edge classes, roles, or cardinality boundaries, stop adding member guards. Derive an open source-native topology generator, lower every element through one plan, and require an independent exact-output topology check whose domain changes automatically when inputs gain producers or edges.
record.source: Portable Defunctionalized Systems v1 World LinkPlan successor

record.learning: In a component linker, reachability governs executable authority and disposition obligations, not whether valid source topology may be rewritten arbitrarily. Ignore unreachable effect declarations and exclude unreachable failure obligations, but preserve unreachable helper blocks, edges, definitions, and dominance. Consume compiler-owned admission facts, materialize dispositions in one plan, and prove element-wise source-to-linked mappings; aggregate counts cannot establish topology equality.
evidence: Serial review of World 5e47c29 found block-by-block dead self-loops breaking valid helper SSA, unreachable effect declarations rejected despite Boundary admission, and count-only topology tests unable to detect mapping substitutions.
Boundary f00f536 exposes componentAdmission with admitted reachability, canonical mappings, residual analysis, effective costs, and digests; its full 286-step/271-test proof passes.

World now consumes componentAdmission, preserves unreachable helper edges, skips unreachable Site dispositions, materializes reachable dispositions and Failure layouts, removes System.Root, and renumbers residual metadata.
The topology verifier compares individual values, constants, functions, blocks, instructions, terminators, effect sites, handler IDs, and morphism endpoints.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 16/16 steps and 25/25 tests; zig build check passed 111/111 steps and 66/66 tests.
record.application: For linker topology, separate semantic reachability from structural source validity. Use the compiler's admitted projection as authority, retain dead subgraphs unless a proved impossible terminal alone needs normalization, and require element mappings plus edge preservation rather than cardinality parity.
record.source: World LinkPlan split-owner successor after 5e47c29 review

record.learning: When one semantic map has many use sites, generated topology must be owned once by the map and every site must factor through it. Re-emitting a complete decision structure per occurrence turns a small valid source graph into multiplicative blocks, values, and constants that can exceed the substrate's finite image domain even though one shared construction fits.
evidence: CAS complexity review found a 32-tag Failure morphism duplicated at two fail_value sites, producing 131 linked blocks above Boundary's hard 128-block domain.
World now emits one provider-owned mapping function plus one terminal continuation per site; the same witness links to 70 blocks.
The wide witness executes p00 to s31 and p31 to s00 through the shared map.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 16/16 steps and 32/32 tests; zig build check passed 111/111 steps and 73/73 tests.
record.application: For compilers and code generators, distinguish a semantic definition from its uses. Generate the definition once at its canonical owner, route uses through calls or references, state additive resource scaling, and add a multi-use witness near the substrate's finite limit.
record.source: Portable Defunctionalized Systems v1 shared Failure morphism lowering

record.learning: Moving duplicated semantics to one owner is necessary but not sufficient: choose the owner's representation against every independent substrate limit. When blocks are scarcer than values or instructions, encode a finite total map as one pure select-chain block rather than a branch-and-leaf tree, while retaining O(1) direct specialization for static and single-target cases.
evidence: The one-owner branch tree still used 127 blocks for a valid 64-tag map and exceeded Boundary's 128-block domain with minimal source topology.
The select-chain successor represents the same 64-tag map in one mapper block and eight total linked blocks.
The runtime witness executes p00 to s63 and p63 to s00; the topology verifier checks every constant, condition, target, select operand, value type, call, and continuation.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 16/16 steps and 32/32 tests; zig build check passed 112/112 steps and 73/73 tests.
record.application: After canonicalizing a generated semantic owner, compare block, value, constant, instruction, state, and byte growth separately. Keep the tightest resource dimension constant when another admitted dimension can carry the finite work, and prove the maximum admitted cardinality rather than a comfortable midpoint.
record.source: Portable Defunctionalized Systems v1 select-chain Failure morphism lowering

record.learning: Before allocating generated resources, quotient source identities by the semantic value or terminal they denote. Intern distinct mapped targets, specialize quotient-size-one maps directly, and share terminal adapters by function and result; otherwise source multiplicity can exhaust finite substrate domains despite equivalent O(1) or quotient-sized realizations.
evidence: CAS review found 256-tag constant and alternating-two-target maps, 43 identical direct failures, and 43 void exits rejected by source-occurrence allocation.
World now interns mapped targets, classifies by quotient size, shares direct adapters by function/target, and shares one void-return adapter.
Focused proof passes 16/16 with 36/36 tests; aggregate passes 112/112 with 77/77 tests.
record.application: For compilers and linkers, derive semantic equivalence classes before sizing values, constants, blocks, continuations, or metadata; prove allocation scales with quotient cardinality and owner count rather than source occurrence count.

record.learning: When a component-local total Failure morphism must cover failures raised inside instructions, lower each instruction role to an explicit target-Failure value and intern those values by mapped target at the owning block. Per-block quotienting preserves SSA availability while preventing the resource growth of per-instruction constants and keeps every failure path under one declared morphism.
evidence: A provider with Failure { arithmetic_overflow } and root Failure { mapped } now executes overflowing integer_add through ordinary BPI1 evaluator semantics v2 and returns root mapped.
The exact topology verifier independently checks each generated Failure constant, root Failure value type, and appended instruction operand.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 17/17 steps and 40/40 tests.
zig build check passed 113/113 steps and 81/81 tests, including Application ABI and clean-room archive compatibility.
record.application: For instruction-local implicit effects, make the destination value explicit at the semantic owner, allocate it where SSA dominance is guaranteed, quotient by semantic target within that scope, and include the generated cost only in compatibility metering. Do not add per-occurrence adapters or a second runtime handler.
record.source: actuating Portable Defunctionalized Systems v1 World linker remediation

record.learning: A feature being outside the accepted Goal does not make a false public statement about that feature nonmaterial. Separate behavior authority from claim accuracy: reject requests to add unsupported capability, but narrow documentation and publication text whenever the implementation admits less or more than the current claim says.
evidence: CAS native-default standard confirmation 01a04b6e-dbd9-7861-8fec-d0d571d1745c found docs/system.md:73-74 claiming all already-linked Programs are rejected while src/system_v1.zig:354-361 admits linked Programs with empty binding rows.
Review Fold captured the exact public-contract witness as CEX-9d892fd1455d1678a7153b53.
After narrowing only the claim, zig build check-world-system-link-v1 passed 17/17 steps and 42/42 tests, and zig build check passed 113/113 steps and 83/83 tests.
record.application: During review adjudication, classify the requested capability and the truthfulness of existing public claims separately. A non-goal can justify declining implementation, but it cannot justify retaining inaccurate docs, PR bodies, release notes, or compatibility statements.

record.learning: In Zig comptime APIs, a private marker type exposed through any public value is recoverable and structurally reusable; it cannot provide unforgeable provenance. When two public input roles overlap structurally, classify the owner-defined semantic interface first and treat wrappers as explicit relation data. Require constructor custody only when provenance is itself an authorized observation.
evidence: CAS soundness and footgun reviews recovered World BindingKind through world.systemExternal(...).binding_kind and used it on a valid Boundary Site, invalidating the nominal-brand distinction.
Review Fold captured the same-claim recurrence as CEX-1b8517aa23789f79cd974fc4 after prior CEX-459a6270abf56ca03062e996.

The successor removes the external brand, gives Boundary Payload/Resume/semantic_identity Site semantics precedence, and passes 19/19 focused steps with 49/49 tests plus 115/115 aggregate steps with 90/90 tests.
record.application: For Zig type-level builders, distinguish semantic roles by the interfaces and relations the consumer actually observes. Do not claim a private enum or token is nominally unforgeable once a public returned type exposes it; either make provenance irrelevant or move authority to a boundary that can enforce opacity.

record.learning: A portable schema digest identifies canonical wire shape, not every source-level semantic role that happens to use that shape. In a typed linker, use schema digests where the runtime contract is explicitly structural, preserve exact authoring types for Control IR roles and typed morphisms, and let the substrate's image emitter perform final structural schema interning.
evidence: Globally changing World schema collection and indexing from exact Zig types to boundary.schema.schemaDigest collapsed distinct root InitialArgs, Result, Failure, and constant-result roles that share one wire shape.
zig build check-world-system-link-v1 then failed with Control IR entry/result and constant/result type mismatches across existing WideFailure and authored-instruction fixtures.
Boundary image_emit_v1 already documents and tests structurally interned, nominally neutral BPI schemas, so source-type collapse duplicated the runtime owner's job.

Restricting digest equality to bare residual-effect authority matching while retaining exact typed endpoints restored 19/19 focused steps with 51/51 tests and 115/115 aggregate steps with 92/92 tests.
record.application: When composing typed programs into a portable image, distinguish source typing identity from runtime schema identity. Apply structural equality only at an explicitly structural interface such as a residual EffectRequest contract; do not globally rewrite authoring types to their wire-equivalent representative unless the substrate exposes a validated typed coercion boundary.
